verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents official SDKs across a dozen+ platforms (server and client-side, e.g. rollbar.js supporting React, Angular, Express, Next.js) backed by a REST API used by these SDKs, which supports building AI-native integrations against them. However, evidence lacks explicit AI-native framework integrations, language coverage details, or SDK quality/maintenance signals beyond basic docs. missing for 10: independent corroboration of SDK reliability/maintenance, broader language/platform SDK list, AI-specific SDK usage examples beyond MCP server.
